name: The Left Behind: A Forgotten Hill Tale
summary:
Many children have been kidnapped. During a turbulent day, they were all set free. All but one. Today it is time for him to try to escape the horrors of the Museum…

Ready to come back to the Museum of Forgotten Hill after the events happened in Forgotten Hill Disillusion? In this brand new Forgotten Hill Tale you will explore a new section of the museum playing as a Nynchkuddy that Mr. Larson somehow forgot to rescue, will you escape?
